item.title: Looks like a scenic area! Cute house! C. 1945 in Idaho. $349,000
item.description: This looks like a scenic area! The house is cute! The home was built in 1945. It is located on .55 acre in Sagle, Idaho. The house features a small covered front porch, knotty pine and wood floors. There is a detached storage shed on the property. There are perennial flower beds and lake access. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,528 square feet. $349,000 Contact Brittney Abbott with Century 21 Riverstone: 208-304-5413 From the Zillow listing: This lovely 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home is only two

item.title: Look at the woodwork! Five acres in Illinois. $225,000
item.description: Take a look at the beautiful woodwork inside this house! Nice acreage too! The house was built in 1908. It is located on five acres in Cambridge, Illinois. The house features an enclosed front porch, beautiful wood floors, grand staircase, original fretwork, leaded glass, wide baseboards, built-in bookshelves, pocket doors, pretty mantels and a huge kitchen. There are a couple of large outbuildings on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,904 square feet. $225,000 Contact Tammy Hamerl

item.title: Nice porch! Pretty setting! One acre in North Carolina. $215,000
item.description: This house has a nice porch and a pretty yard! Love the mature trees. The house was built in 1921. It is located on one acre in the village of Yeatesville – Pinetown, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, original wood floors, bead board, wide baseboards, crown moulding, spacious kitchen and vintage tiled bathroom. The house could definitely use some color. There is a detached garage and an attic. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,819 square feet. $215,000 Contact

item.title: Pretty interior! Huge finished basement with second kitchen. C. 1948 in Virginia. $365,000
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! There is a large finished basement with a second kitchen. Great for in-laws or guests. The house was built in 1948. It is located on .81 acre in Pulaski, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, chair rails, crown moulding, built-in corner cabinet, updated kitchen, built-in kitchen booth seating, updated bathrooms and a large finished basement. Three bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,182 square feet. $365,000 Contact Dar

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Four acres in Virginia. $120,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! Wish they had taken pictures on a sunny day. The house was built in 1946. It is located on four acres in Fiedale, Virginia. The house features a screened in side porch, original wood floors, baseboards, knotty pine, crown moulding and a basement. Not far from the Blue Ridge Mountains. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,018 square feet. $120,000 Contact Helen McKenzie with Jacobs Real Estate: 434-709-8083 From the Zillow listing: Spacious mid-ce

item.title: Talk Amongst Yourselves! C. 1869. On 20 acres in Indiana. $499,900
item.description: Talk amongst yourselves! Looked like a great house from the exterior! The interior is like a hunting lodge and a pizza hut salad bar. The house was built in 1868. It is located on 20 acres in Lakeville, Indiana. There is paneling in seven competing wood tones and a cast iron stove that looks ready to judge you. I’m not saying it’s haunted, but if a man name Earl appears offering you a Coors, just go with it! Five bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,976 square feet. $499,900 Contact Adam Pendl with eXp

item.title: Nice interior! Circa 1912 in Kansas. $200,000
item.description: This house has a nice interior! Pretty woodwork! The house was built in 1912. It is located on .35 acre in Stockton, Kansas. The house features a large covered front porch, a vestibule, original wood floors, large pocket doors, picture rails, chair rails and baseboards. item.title: Love this! Circa 1911 in Louisiana. $279,000
item.description: Love this house! It has a lot of pretty details! The house was built in 1911. It is located in Morgan City, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, tall ceilings, bead board, wide baseboards, transom windows, crown moulding and a claw foot tub. There is a large back yard, huge patio, big oak trees and a detached storage shed. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,852 square feet. $279,000 Contact Calyn Welch with Simon Real Estate: 985-518-3091 From the Zillow list

item.title: Thomas Walter Long House, Circa 1882 in North Carolina. $230,000
item.description: This house has some pretty details inside! Nice staircase! The Thomas Walter Long House was built in 1882. It is located on .38 acre in Catawba, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, nice staircase, wainscoting, crown moulding, pretty mantels and bead board. There is a fenced in backyard and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,439 square feet. $230,000 Contact Tori Cearlock with Three and Company: cearlockproperties@gmail.com From the Z

item.title: 20 bedrooms! The Merrill House. On 126 acres in Maine. $2,250,000
item.description: This is a huge place with 20 bedrooms! A lot of history with this house. Known as the Merrill House. Originally built in 1790.IT is located on 126 acres in Andover, Maine. In 1900 it was expanded by Henry Varnum Poor, founder of Standard and Poor’s, later the S&P 500. The property has gardens, trails and expansive views. The house is near a lot of outdoor activities. Twenty bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 9,000 square feet. $2,250,000 Contact Coldwell Banker Realty: 207-967-9900 From the Zillow li
